title: Solo Crisis (Demo)
overview:
Guide Your Servants and Strike the Devil's Stronghold!

A new kind of two-sided simulation: where the front side becomes a mountain, the back side becomes a valley! In this world you become a god and face off against the devil who controls monsters in the world on the other side. Guide the servants chosen from the front-side world (leaders, warriors, archers, workers, wizards and priests), overcome obstacles with the power of miracles, and destroy the devil's temple!

シモベを導き、悪魔の本拠地を叩け！

表が山になれば裏では谷になる、新感覚の表裏一体型シミュレーション！この世界であなたは神となり、裏側の世界で魔物たちを操る悪魔と対決します。表側の世界から選ばれたシモベたち（指導者・戦士・弓兵・工民・魔法使い・僧侶）を導き、奇跡の力で障害を乗り越えて、悪魔の神殿を破壊しましょう！
